name: uizze/uizze-codex-ui-finish-gate
summary: Dependency-free Codex UI implementation workflow that makes completion pass through a written design contract, five explicit product states, deterministic behavior checks, rendered desktop and narrow-width review, and an evidence log.
evidence: The documented default path starts Codex in the template, has it read the repository task and guidance, and requires fresh verification plus rendered inspection before completion.
AGENTS.md, TASK.md, UI_CONTRACT.md, and RUN_LOG.md encode a reusable contract-to-implementation-to-review workflow with explicit completion evidence.
The dependency-free verifier and its tests intentionally reject the incomplete seed, exercise five query states, and accept a complete fixture without pretending to automate visual judgment.
